messages:
Emma (CSM): Acme onboarding hit a couple of issues during today's ramp — intermittent 401s followed by 429 spikes. Can someone triage?

Sanjay (Acme Eng): Yep seeing it. Started right after we rotated the org API key. SDK v0.9.3 on all instances. Example error in logs: "401 Unauthorized" then automatic retry -> 429. Request-Id: rq_9c3b2f1a

Mira (DevEx): Can you paste your SDK init/config? Also, did you rotate the key across all hosts at once or rolling?

Sanjay (Acme Eng): config snippet:
```json
{"base_url": "https://api.redwood.example", "api_key": "REDACTED", "concurrency": 80, "auto_retry": true}
```

Sanjay (Acme Eng): log snippet (trimmed):
```
[t=12:03:21] request rq_9c3b2f1a -> 401 Unauthorized
[t=12:03:21] sdk retry immediate -> request rq_9c3b2f1b -> 429 Too Many Requests (Retry-After: 1)
[t=12:03:22] repeated 401/429 across other hosts
```

ingest-bot: RateLimit alert: org=acme burst=1200/min window=60s -> enforcement to 600/min. Threshold crossed at 12:03:22 UTC.

Emma (CSM): Acme admits they rotated the key simultaneously on ~30 hosts plus a couple of auto-scaled lambdas. Looks like some hosts used the old key while others used the new one, causing auth failures and a fanout of retries. Immediate mitigation: disable SDK auto_retry, reduce concurrency to ~20, and pause horizontal scaling while we re-roll.

Mira (DevEx): Confirmed behavior — v0.9.3 has a known issue where it retries without re-validating header propagation, which can magnify auth rollovers into rate spikes. Workarounds: upgrade to v0.9.5 (fix included) or set `auto_retry=false` and `retry_strategy=exponential_jitter`.

Mira (DevEx): Upgrade command: `pip install redwood-sdk==0.9.5` or in node: `npm i @redwood/sdk@0.9.5` — this version waits 50-200ms with jitter before retrying auth failures and re-reads env-provided keys.

Sanjay (Acme Eng): Rolling upgrade now and doing a rolling key rotation (10% of hosts per minute). Will report back in ~10m. Any quick way to identify which hosts used the old key?

Emma (CSM): We can match Request-Id prefixes to host IDs — look for ids starting with `rq_9c3b-badhost` pattern (DMing hostlist). Also, we can temporarily bump the org rate limit for this account to ease the flood while they roll.

deploy-bot: Support ticket CS-2026 created and assigned to eng-infra.

Mira (DevEx): Follow-up: we'll add a short note to the onboarding runbook: "When rotating API keys, perform rolling rotations and disable SDK-wide auto-retry; monitor request-ids for mismatched host prefixes." I'll also PR a guide to the docs. :thumbsup:

Sanjay (Acme Eng): Upgrade + roll complete — traffic normalized, no more 401/429 chain. Thanks for the fast help.

Emma (CSM): Great, I'll file this as an onboarding learn and flag renewal risk as mitigated.

Mira (DevEx): I'll attach the troubleshooting traces to CS-2026 and drop the doc PR link once merged."
